question: Should CodexBar accept forwarding every longcat.chat browser cookie when the specific LongCat authentication cookie names are undocumented?
rationale: Tests can verify transport mechanics but cannot determine whether the complete-cookie credential scope is an acceptable product and security boundary.

options.title: Require a minimal cookie set
options.body: Identify the necessary LongCat authentication cookies from redacted live diagnostics and allowlist only those names before merge.

options.title: Accept complete-cookie forwarding
options.body: Explicitly accept the disabled-by-default full-domain cookie jar after real-account proof confirms isolation, expiry handling, and no sensitive logging.

options.title: Defer the provider
options.body: Pause or close the integration if the authentication contract cannot be validated without forwarding unrelated browser credentials.

recommendation.title: Require a minimal cookie set
recommendation.body: Identify the necessary LongCat authentication cookies from redacted live diagnostics and allowlist only those names before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available authority for a new provider credential boundary and privacy tradeoff.
